hook: Newly unsealed records from October 2026 expose a secret helper in the 1994 murders.

sections.voiceover: In 1994, Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman were killed in Los Angeles. Federal documents reviewed by the New York Times revealed new details. Where did the potential murder weapon go?
sections.visual_cue: Historical photograph of Los Angeles crime scene tape from 1994.
b_roll: Los Angeles 1994 crime scene archive footage

sections.voiceover: Convicted drug smuggler Joseph Ippolito had a brother who helped.

sections.voiceover: Joseph Ippolito and his brother helped O.J. Simpson dispose of the weapon. Convicted drug smuggler Joseph Ippolito died in 2006 after years on the run. CBS News and The Times detailed records about Joseph Ippolito.
sections.visual_cue: Archival portrait photograph of Joseph Ippolito next to court papers.

sections.voiceover: The 1994 case files remain sealed no longer.
